video_title: Rich Paul Controls The Whole NBA And Perk Just Explained How

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors pursuing LeBron James and Anthony Davis in trade
quotes.excerpt: the Golden State Warriors are planning to pursue LeBron James in free agency and Anthony Davis via trade

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Channing Frye is reporting that the Golden State Warriors are planning to pursue LeBron James in free agency and Anthony Davis via trade this week. Team and league sources indicated that Green declined the player option and that would turn down one-year financial guarantee to work on a new contract with the Warriors, lowering his salary for next season only if it freed up immediate flexibility for Golden State to secure a significant roster upgrade.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors pursuing stars would be a smart, high-stakes move
quotes.excerpt: we are going to go shoot to the moon and if we land on the stars
quotes.quote: If you are like, hey Steph, we do not have many options, but listen, we are going to go shoot to the moon and if we land on the stars, one, you are going to sell crazy amounts of tickets. Two, that is a very smart team. Three, that is an old, old team. I do not know what your bench is going to look like, I do not know what your roster setup is going to look like, but if that happens, everyone is going to talk about it. You are basically putting Team USA together, but like old Team USA.

text_blocks.text: Draymond is represented by who? Clutch. Anthony Davis is represented by who? Clutch. LeBron James is represented by who? Rich Paul. quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Contract negotiations for Trae Young, Anthony Davis, and LeBron James

quotes.quote: Trae Young just got 200 plus million. It is also a contract negotiation there for Anthony Davis if it is one with the Wizards, and obviously people want to know what the hell is going to go on with LeBron and the Lakers because the Lakers just gave Austin Reaves the bag. And the one thing that we do know is that that little short motherfucker that walk around that got a podcast that do outstanding job is that you better not call his bluff.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: David Falk's historical influence as a super-agent
quotes.excerpt: David Falk was the first puppet master the NBA had ever seen.
quotes.quote: For the people that like to talk about Rich Paul, Channing, myself, Perk, we grew up in an era, there is a guy named David Falk. You should go look at David Falk. David Falk was the first puppet master the NBA had ever seen. There are certain guys that are just very, very powerful, and there are agents that learn how to maneuver to the top. Sometimes I look at Rich Paul and just say he is following the David Falk move.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers need to build a championship roster around Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: you get Luka coming off a finals and then you get Luka in LA, now the clock starts.
quotes.quote: I think the Lakers would be taking a step back if LeBron James decided to leave. But I also think that they have got some work to do to make themselves as competitive as they should. One thing that they have to realize is that they took and got Luka coming off a finals. So you get Luka coming off a finals and then you get Luka in LA, now the clock starts. You have to build a championship roster around Luka and you do not have five, six years to do it. You got two or three. I like Austin Reaves signing, I think he earned every single dollar. There are things that you have to address around Austin Reaves as his usage rate has gone up, his games have gone down. They need defenders around that backcourt of Luka and Austin. I think they are the best offensive backcourt in the league, and that includes SGA and Jalen Williams, that includes Anthony Edwards and his new running mate LaMelo. I think the best offensive backcourt is Luka and Austin, but I will also say that the area that they also might be the backcourt that needs the most help defensively.
